hypothesis: Averaging the champion over all 120 suit permutations at each real decision removes residual arbitrary suit-slot preferences, while retaining the validated 20-way sampled continuation model and all rollout compute, shortlist, gating, objective, and exact-tail settings.

source.runtime_provenance_requirement: Every raw shard must bind the SHA-256 of this plan file, bin/arena, and data/champion.bin in --provenance.

candidate_definition.only_intended_change: real-root suit symmetry averaging increases from 20 to 120; playout_symmetries remains 20

prior_evidence.status: exploratory_and_selection_biased; excluded from every gate and final estimate

stage_1_policy_compute_gate.purpose: Qualify whether to spend full rollout compute. This stage can reject or advance the fixed candidate but can never promote it.
stage_1_policy_compute_gate.combination: Invert block two to the candidate perspective, then equal-weight the two independent blocks. Combined SE is sqrt(SE1^2 + SE2^2) / 2.
advance_gate: combined candidate match score minus 1.645 standard errors exceeds 0.5
candidate match-score point estimate exceeds 0.5 in each orientation
no cap-terminated rounds, incomplete shards, provenance mismatch, gaps, overlaps, or operational errors

stage_2_full_actor_gate.purpose: Independent deployment test; this stage alone can promote the candidate.
stage_2_full_actor_gate.conditional_execution: Run only if stage 1 passes every advance gate. Do not alter either actor specification after stage 1.

planned_looks.action_if_promotion_gate_fails: Continue unless a nonbinding operational or futility stop is taken; stopping cannot support promotion or a claim of inferiority.
Do not promote; report the fixed result as unvalidated or negative according to its interval.

promotion_gate_at_each_look: combined candidate match score z statistic exceeds that look's predeclared critical value
candidate match-score point estimate exceeds 0.5 in each reciprocal orientation
no cap-terminated rounds, incomplete shards, provenance mismatch, gaps, overlaps, or operational errors
stage_2_full_actor_gate.combination: At each look, invert block two to the candidate perspective and equal-weight the independent reciprocal blocks. Do not pool the two block variances.

reporting: Keep policy-stage and actor-stage estimates separate; never pool exploratory data or policy proxy games into deployment strength.

Report reciprocal orientation estimates, combined match score and pair-clustered SE, point margin and SE, W/L/D, cap count, elapsed time, model hash, arena hash, plan hash, compiler, and exact commands.
Report the inference/runtime cost of 120-way real-root averaging without reducing rollout worlds to equalize time.
